description: This file defines the RunMode class which manages the configuration for testing modes in the OrangeHRM Selenium test suite. It primarily determines if tests are to be run in discovery-only mode based on system properties.

classes.name: RunMode
classes.description: Utility class to determine test run mode, particularly if tests should run in discovery-only mode based on system properties.

methods.name: isDiscoveryOnly
methods.description: Checks the 'orangehrm.discoveryOnly' system property to decide if tests should run in discovery-only mode. Defaults to true if property is not set.
